definitions.gloss: exterior material; cladding material; facade material
definitions.explanation: Materials used for the outer surface of a building, such as siding, tiles, stone, or panels. These materials protect the structure from weather while also determining its visual appearance.

examples.japanese: {外装材|がいそうざい}の{色|いろ}を{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: Choose the color of the exterior material.

examples.japanese: {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}の{高|たか}い{外装材|がいそうざい}を{使|つか}うことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to use highly durable exterior materials.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{外装材|がいそうざい}の{一部|いちぶ}が{剥|は}がれたので、{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{修理|しゅうり}を{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: Part of the exterior cladding came off in the typhoon, so we asked a contractor to repair it.

notes:
A construction term composed of {外装|がいそう} (exterior finish) and {材|ざい} (material). Common exterior materials in Japan include サイディング (siding panels), タイル (tiles), {漆喰|しっくい} (plaster), and {板張|いたば}り (wood cladding).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外装材|がいそうざい}の{張|は}り{替|か}え: replacing exterior cladding
- {外装材|がいそうざい}の{選定|せんてい}: selection of exterior materials
- {金属|きんぞく}{外装材|がいそうざい}: metal cladding
- {外装材|がいそうざい}メーカー: exterior material manufacturer

RELATED WORDS:
- {外壁|がいへき}: exterior wall — the wall itself, not just the surface material
- {内装材|ないそうざい}: interior material — the counterpart for indoor finishes
- {外装|がいそう}: exterior finish — the broader concept including design and construction
